posts.content: 🎉 Excited to share that I've been selected for the Smart India Hackathon 2024! Our team "CircuitBreakers" will be working on a smart grid monitoring system. Any tips from seniors who've participated before? #SIH2024 #ECE #RIT

Just completed my final year project on "AI-based PCB Defect Detection using Computer Vision". The system achieved 97.3% accuracy! Huge thanks to my guide Prof. Ramesh for the constant support. 🔬

Technologies used: Python, OpenCV, TensorFlow, Raspberry Pi

#FinalYearProject #ComputerVision #ECE

📢 Internship Alert!

Texas Instruments is hiring ECE interns for Summer 2024. Roles available:
- Analog Design Intern
- Digital Verification Intern
- Test Engineering Intern

Location: Bangalore
Stipend: ₹40,000-60,000/month

Apply before Nov 30. DM me for referrals! 💼

Attended an amazing workshop on "RISC-V Processor Design" organized by the ECE department today. Built a basic 5-stage pipeline processor in Verilog! The future of open-source hardware is exciting. 🖥️

#RISCV #VLSIDesign #Workshop

Proud to announce that our research paper "Energy-Efficient Routing Protocol for IoT Networks using Reinforcement Learning" has been accepted at IEEE CONECCT 2024! 📄✨

First publication as a UG student — couldn't be happier! Thanks to my co-authors and Prof. Lakshmi.

#Research #IEEE #IoT #ReinforcementLearning

Tips for juniors preparing for placement season:

1️⃣ Start DSA early (at least 6 months before)
2️⃣ Build 2-3 solid projects
3️⃣ Practice aptitude daily
4️⃣ Work on communication skills
5️⃣ Get your resume reviewed by seniors/alumni
6️⃣ Attend mock interviews
7️⃣ Don't ignore core ECE subjects

Good luck, batch of 2025! 💪

🏆 Won 2nd place at HackFest 2024 organized by IIT Madras!

Our project: A wearable health monitoring device using ESP32 that tracks vitals and predicts anomalies using TinyML.

Team: Arjun K, Priya V, Vikram S
Prize: ₹50,000

Amazing experience competing against 200+ teams! #Hackathon #IoT #TinyML

Looking for study partners for GATE 2025 preparation! I'm focusing on:
- Signals & Systems
- Control Systems
- Digital Electronics
- Network Theory

Planning to form a study group. Interested people, drop a comment! 📚

#GATE2025 #ECE
